goal: Add a model provider layer in contextos/llm/: one shared interface, with Anthropic, OpenAI and Ollama providers plus a FakeProvider for tests. Pick the provider with CONTEXTOS_PROVIDER, and read keys only from environment variables. Build the pack builder that turns a conversation into a Context Pack. Long chats are summarized in pieces, and those summaries are then combined.
rollback_plan: Delete contextos/llm/, contextos/pack/builder.py, tests/test_pack_builder.py and .env.example; remove the anthropic and openai extras from pyproject.toml and the provider section from README.md.
approvals_required: Human approved on 2026-11-04: anthropic and openai Python packages as optional extras only (contextos[anthropic], contextos[openai]); Ollama uses the standard library.
